quote.question: Help me price a job: four inspections at UGX 80,000 each, with a 10% discount.
quote.prose: At your original figures, four inspections total UGX 288,000 after the discount.
quote.code:
root = Col([Title("Inspection quote", "xl"), Card([Title(@Format($quantity * $price * (1 - $discount / 100), "currency", 0, "UGX"), "2xl"), Caption("Total after discount")], "soft"), Form([Input($quantity, "Inspections", "number"), Input($price, "Price per inspection (UGX)", "number"), Slider($discount, 0, 100, 1, "Discount", "%")]), Accordion("Calculation", [Text(@Format($quantity * $price, "currency", 0, "UGX") + " before discount")])], 5)
$quantity = 4
$price = 80000
$discount = 10

images.question: Can you show me the tallest buildings pictures
images.prose: Compare these photographs of Burj Khalifa, Merdeka 118 and Shanghai Tower.
images.code:
root = Col([Title("Tallest buildings", "xl"), Carousel([burj, merdeka, shanghai], 240, 4), Caption("Swipe to compare the photographs.")], 5)
burj = Card([SearchImage("Burj Khalifa Dubai", 0.85), Title("Burj Khalifa", "lg"), Text("Dubai, United Arab Emirates")])
merdeka = Card([SearchImage("Merdeka 118 Kuala Lumpur", 0.85), Title("Merdeka 118", "lg"), Text("Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia")])
shanghai = Card([SearchImage("Shanghai Tower", 0.85), Title("Shanghai Tower", "lg"), Text("Shanghai, China")])

plan.question: Organise my afternoon: read the brief, make a draft, then review it.
plan.prose: Start with the brief, make a draft, then review it.
plan.code:
root = Col([Title("Your afternoon", "xl"), List([ListItem("Start", "Read the brief", "14:00"), ListItem("Focus", "Make the first draft", "14:30"), ListItem("Review", "Take a break and revise", "16:00")], "none", true), Popover("Why this order?", "Start with understanding, then make something concrete."), Accordion("Checklist", [Checkbox($read, "Brief read"), Checkbox($draft, "Draft ready"), Text($read && $draft ? "Ready to review" : "Keep going")])], 5)
$read = false
$draft = false

plain.question: Explain in two plain sentences why fuel costs vary with distance
plain.text: Driving farther uses more fuel because the engine works for longer. The cost also depends on fuel price, traffic and how efficiently the vehicle uses fuel.
